title: Show the last active session name in the browser tab
outcome: Update the Chrome/browser document title from the most recently active session so users can distinguish TermAl windows and tabs while navigating many projects. Preserve the last session title when a non-session workspace tab becomes active and fall back to TermAl before any session has been opened.
acceptance: Opening or activating a session updates document.title with that session name; switching to a non-session panel keeps the last active session name; a fresh app with no opened session displays TermAl; title updates are covered by deterministic UI tests; TypeScript and production UI build pass.

completion.summary: Verification-only closure. The browser tab title delivered by 1fa9cf7d (later extended by 2ff939b9), both ancestors of master 1495e8d3. useLastActiveSessionDocumentTitle sets "<session> · TermAl", keeps the last session across non-session tabs, and falls back to "TermAl", covered by browser-session-title.test.tsx and App smoke/workspace-layout assertions. The production UI build (`tsc --noEmit && vite build`) passed on master 1495e8d3 (Opus2, log .logs/ui-dist-build-1495e8d3.log). Independent evaluation 8d5c61b9 passed 1/1.
